segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Pip’s ears twitched forward. He dropped to all four paws, crawled over to the drift, and pressed his fuzzy ear directly into the snow.

segments.speaker: pip
segments.text: You're right. It's the stolen time. The Clockmaker’s machinery isn't just dumping Christmas magic into your world—it's vacuuming up everything else and burying it in the snow!

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Underneath the jumble of summer picnics and birthday parties, you hear a rhythmic, metallic whisper ticking in time with the distant Grand Clock:

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: When the thirteenth bell sighs... the cog turns where the cold river lies.

segments.speaker: hero
segments.text: Did you hear that part? When the thirteenth bell sighs, the cog turns where the cold river lies!

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Pip froze. He slowly stood up on his hind legs, dusted off his knees, and pulled a tattered little notebook and pencil stub from his coat pocket.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Pip gasped, his accent slipping into genuine frustration.

segments.speaker: pip
segments.text: That blasted phrase again! I’ve been hearing that infernal riddle for three weeks! I searched Santa’s deep-freeze ice cellar—nothing but frozen eggnog! I searched the Glacier Caves—nothing but grumpy polar bears!

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Pip threw his little paws in the air.

segments.speaker: pip
segments.text: What in St. Nick's beard does 'where the cold river lies' mean?!

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: What do you tell Pip this clue means?
